name: GolfTeeSheetManager
tagline: Tee sheet, starter and pace of play in one Power Platform control.
description: A complete golf operations app for resort golf desks and golf & country clubs: multi-tee tee sheet with drag-and-drop and members-only windows, starter and marshal pace-of-play board, bookings with bulk actions, carts and green fees – for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Capacity per tee time across parties
Drag-and-drop and keyboard moves with rule checks
Starter: check in, payment before send-off, send off
Pace of play: behind / out of position, expected hole, finish ETA
Green fees by booking type, nine-hole %, cart fee
Bulk confirm, check in, mark paid, cancel, export
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform libraries, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (data-set control + Power Pages field control)
